[00:00.60] Alas, my love, you do me wrong,
[00:06.00] To cast me off discourteously,
[00:15.60] For I have loved you well and long,
[00:21.00] Delighting in your company.
[00:28.20] Greensleeves was all my joy,
[00:33.60] Greensleeves was my delight,
[00:42.60] Greensleeves was my heart of gold,
[00:48.00] And who but my lady Greensleeves.
